decision: Build a Go GitHub CLI extension named gh-arrow; invoke as gh arrow.
rationale: Use the gh extension lifecycle and a familiar command entry point.
supersedes: Independent gha binary and arrow-gha product name.

decision: Use the GitHub API with existing gh credentials obtained through gh auth token; never manage tokens in arrow config.
rationale: Reuse GitHub CLI authentication for public and accessible private repositories.
supersedes: No API authentication; public-only remote access; raw URL and web-page fallback.

decision: Treat doc/design-meta as the specification source and generate doc/design/specification.md with flyb.
rationale: Support structured retrieval for agents and readable review for humans.

decision: Prefer explicit local mappings; never fall back remotely after a mapped file is missing.
rationale: A local mapping deliberately selects the working tree.
supersedes: Clarifies the original missing-local-file edge case.

decision: Use the current hosted repository name gh-arrow for the extension and executable.
rationale: The repository has been renamed to gh-arrow; align invocation with GitHub extension naming conventions.
supersedes: Earlier plan to rename the hosted repository before publication.
